hero.title: Build, manage and play your MESBG army lists.
hero.description: A fast list builder for Middle-earth Strategy Battle Game players, with roster validation, printable cards, digital trackers, match history and collection tools.

new-player.title: Everything you need before, during and after a game
new-player.description: Sign in to create your first roster, manage your collection and keep everything stored safely with your account.

account.title: Create your account
account.description: Keep your rosters, match history, ongoing games and collection stored safely in one place.

build.title: Build your first roster
build.description: Choose an army, add warbands and check points, bows, warriors and validation warnings as you build.

data.title: Bring your hobby data together
data.description: Track games, manage your collection and build a history around the armies you play most.

returning-player.title: Pick up where you left off
returning-player.description: Jump back into your latest rosters, continue an active game, or record your most recent result.

games.title: Resume ongoing game
games.description: Continue tracking Might, Will, Fate, wounds and casualties.

results.title: Add match result
results.description: Log your latest game and keep your match history complete.

features.title: Built around the actual tabletop flow
features.description: Your rosters, match history, ongoing games and collection are tied to your account, so the List Builder can stay consistent across devices without manual syncing.

build.title: Build valid army lists
build.description: Create warbands, add heroes and warriors, track points, bows, throwing weapons and validation warnings.

profiles.title: Use profile cards
profiles.description: Open clean profile cards while building, printing or playing at the table.

play.title: Play with digital trackers
play.description: Track Might, Will, Fate, wounds, break points and casualties during a game.

collect.title: Manage your collection
collect.description: Enable collection checks so lists can warn you when models or loadouts are missing.

track.title: Track match history
track.description: Record results by army, opponent, scenario and points level to learn from your games.

community.title: Made for the community
community.description: Report data issues, suggest improvements and help keep the builder accurate.

preview.title: Prepare, play, review
preview.description: The List Builder follows the full tabletop flow: prepare your roster, use it during the battle, then review your results afterwards.

build.title: Build
build.subtitle: Create legal lists with clear validation.

play.title: Play
play.subtitle: Use your roster during the battle.

flow.title: How it works
flow.description: Create an account once, then build rosters, use them at the table and keep your results and collection data together over time.
